name: com.verdixapi/verdix
title: Verdix address risk
description: Check an EVM address on Base before sending funds: safe/caution/danger. Pays per call via x402.

environmentVariables.name: VERDIX_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Private key of YOUR Base wallet holding a little USDC. Used only locally to sign each x402 payment; never sent anywhere. Needed for check_address_risk, not for get_pricing.

environmentVariables.name: VERDIX_MAX_PRICE_USD
environmentVariables.description: Most this server will pay for one call, in USD. Calls above it are refused before signing. quick=$0.02, standard=$0.10, deep=$0.50.
